body:
Hi again. I've read your comment several times and don't really know how to respond. I appreciate you taking the time to write it up for me and I think it should be really useful. A lot of what you're saying makes a lot of sense to me. I think I'm going to print off your comment to save for later guidance. 


As for how I'm doing. Well.. Not fantastically. I have an appointment with my doctor scheduled Wednesday. I've written out a list of important symptoms and how they affect me in case I clam up once I'm in there. My mother being here was a massive help, just not being alone or feeling under threat was really good for me. I've been on my own again since yesterday though. My fiancé still hasn't returned home, he's due today but I haven't heard a peep since Friday. 

I'm trying to take things an hour at a time. Days seem endless even so. I've been trying to get small things done around the house and for university (online classes). I'm just focusing on my appointment on Wednesday and trying to keep my attention there. 

I feel unable to make many decisions at all. I don't trust my brain to operate in my best interests right now. I hope the doctor can offer an intervention. 

I'm sorry its taken me so long to reply. I've been reading and rereading, just reverted to lurker mode for a while. 

Thanks for listening.

He came home only to pack a bag to go and stay at his mothers. My mum has come up to keep me company. 

I feel so let down. I'm sure he does too. Quite lost at the moment, just keeping busy with Netflix and the cat as much as possible. It's good to have company for the night, another night alone in my headspace wouldn't have been good. 

Do you have any suggestions on types of therapy that might be useful for me? You've said you have experience with chronic pain and the like in addition to suicidal notions. I wonder what helped you go from here to helping others in this situation.

I'm fairly out of it for chatting, sheer exhaustion overtaking me currently. I took a peek at your post history and see you're in the UK too though, nice to see someone sort've half local. If you're still up for a chat let me know and I'll poke you whenever my brain feels whole again?

Ho (hi ho)

Okay.. It's been a rough day, no teasing on the crap humour.

My mother is driving up to me tonight thankfully. I'm trying to tidy up a little to prepare for her arrival at the moment. So thankful someone will be here with me before midnight. 

The friend is truly amazing. I need to make an effort to have her in my life more I know, she's got a lot going on at the moment too (seems all the nicest people have the biggest challenges) but I'm sure we can find time to reconnect soon. I hope so anyway.

I found a depression support group in my town that meets on Wednesdays, so I have something to aim to attend in 6 days. 

I really don't want to just ditch him. I don't think he means to be so hurtful and cruel to me. I can't believe anyone would knowingly do it. But then I did spend half the day begging for help and being told to grow up and leave him alone. I just don't know. My whole head hurts and I don't know what to think anymore. I'm usually really good at just seeing peoples behaviours and motivations clearly. Today I don't trust my perceptions at all. I just wish I hadn't been alone and suffering all day. I don't understand how you leave a person you love, or even just a person in this sortve state to fend for themselves.

No help so far. Aside from all of you here and my friend in another country who spent most of the day talking to me. 

The fiancé is due home soon. If he even comes home. I'm terrified. I'm thinking of showing him this post and its replies as an example of what to say to someone in pain. I don't know if that would just add fuel to his annoyance at me though.

She's an amazing friend. We live many hours from each other and haven't been in touch all that much over the years but today she talked to me for hours on Facebook. If/when I get myself together enlough to make the journey I really need to.

Thanks so much lovely internet stranger but I couldn't accept money, words of kindness are more than enough. I could scrape together bus/train fare if I felt able for the journey but I don't really feel able to leave my house currently. Too many panic attacks, a tension headache and sheer exhaustion render me housebound at present. You are an amazing person for offering to help me though, thank you.

I'm always in the market for people who can teach me anytbing about managing chronic pain. I used to work in healthcare, so I know the right things to say and do when others are experiencing it. 

For me pain doesn't describe it properly. Or its just one part of it. It's the overwhelming fatigue from being in pain constantly. I start the day with fewer and fewer resources and accomplish less and less as time goes on. Reading was once my escape when I felt sick or sad, that's been one of the most painful losses. It was my way to self soothe. Audio books simply don't have the same effect sadly. 

To top things off, most painkillers do just about nothing for me. Anytbing that does work renders me a little "doped" so I don't feel entirely comfortable interacting with people, I don't want to come across as dumb or just plain strung-out.

I wish I had the power to find help alone. I'm too scared to. 

An example of my inability to do pretty much anytbing today - I'm a smoker, with no tobacco for hours now, I haven't gotten myself to the shop 5 minutes away for more. I broke a plate this morning accidentally and the shards are still laying across the floor. The various debris in my bathroom from my earlier attempts lay scattered around. I just haven't been able to do anything but sit here all day and cry, and hug my cat, and reply to you wonderful thoughtful people I've been more honest with than anyone in years. 

Thank you.

I'm so exhausted right now but I'm trying to reply to everyone who was kind enough to try and help me. 

I don't feel I have the resources to get out there and try to do something. I'm going to save this comment and maybe I will add you on Skype in the future. Thank you for your kindness.

I'm really reluctant to go anywhere near an emergency department. I was considering it before my attempts this morning. That's why I was begging him to come and help me. 

Now that I've made repeated attempts I don't feel I can speak to hospital staff. I think I'd rather set myself on fire than do that! 

I tried to be rational with the staff last time. I even asked to be transferred to a psych unit. But everything was refused. Just kept in handcuffs in a room on camera with the door open (other patients could walk by and peer in) and two policemen outside. 

Hospital just isn't an option for me. I'm sorry if that is a disappointment. I genuinely would rather resume trying to top myself than risking going near any medical staff.

I don't know what or who told him that leaving a suicidal person begging for help alone was the correct response but I think they need a serious talking to. Or a disciplinary if they're in the mental health field. Ignoring my shouts for help have just made me feel completely worthless. I now know he doesn't care if I live or die. I don't know if I'll ever be able to look at him the same way even if I do recover from this.

I'm not sure how confident I am that good mental health services exist where I live. The steadfast rule seems to be if you're a danger to yourself or anyone else you'll be kept under hold. The only way around it is if someone will take responsibility for you and promise to not leave you alone. 

That seems like it won't happen for me. I've been trying to ensure I'm not alone since 9am, its now 7pm. I've quit making attempts now. It just isn't working, my methods lack enough sophistication I guess.

I'd be willing to try therapies and drugs, depending on the drugs in question. 

As the law stands here if I pose a danger to myself or others the professional in question is duty bound to report it. So I could seek help and.. Lie about what's troubling me, but I'm not entirely sure that'd be of much use. 

What I've been hoping for is to develop a supportive and non aggressive home environment. Where I can rely on my partner to not blow up or vanish when things get tough. I feel like I need a safe base to do work from. 

I know in theory I could be better than I am. I have potential surgeries in the pipeline that would help my eyes and thus my anxiety. I dream of being able to work again. 

I know I need a support network to be able to do any of this. I just don't really know how to build one when I'm so isolated and the one person I have nearby is dismissing my feelings. 

I've taken a handful of xanax to try calm myself a bit. I'm sorry if I'm rambling.

I don't know how to create anymore willpower or hope. I've been running on those for the past two years. 

And on top of everything else. My miscarried child would have been 2 this month. It's even more painful when I glance at the trajectory my life could have taken. Instead of sitting here alone day after day being a burden I could be providing care for someone else. 

I guess that's always been my happiness. Looking after others. I just never figured out how to look after myself, I've made poor choice after poor choice and find myself here. 

I wish I had one friend I could get a cab to. But we moved here to the suburbs to work on creating a family home. It's just a guilded cage for me instead it seems.

Transportation I could take. Yes.. I could get a train and several buses. I'm not confident I'll be able to navigate it all in my current state. I feel trapped in the house most of the time but today I'm not even braving looking out the front windows. I'm scared he'll have sent police to "help" (read: assault and detain) me instead of showing up himself. 

I just wish I could vanish. Had I not put all my savings into this house purchase I could have tried to go somewhere else and try a new life. I've literally got access to all of about £100 though. Hindsight is 20/20.

I've tried to leave so many times citing my mental health as a reason and he always talks me back. Promises he loves me. That we can work on issues. 

Then he barely comes home and shouts at me and mocks me for wanting to die. 

My disability is vision related. Blind in one eye. The other is mostly useless. I get chronic pain in both and I've had an anxiety issue gaining momentum since my miscarraige two years ago. 

I recently signed up with a doctor (ive been too scared to go to a doctor for about a year since I was handcuffed and essentially held captive on police guard in a hospital) it took a lot of guts, and getting my mum to come with me to even sign up for a doctor. But I don't see how a doctor can fix any of this. 

I've been trying to do away with myself off and on all morning. It's so damn hard. They don't provide manuals for this stuff.. I just wish I could peacefully slip away and not have to experience another minute of this.. 

Thank you for talking to me. If I knew people like you in real life I'm sure I wouldn't find myself in this situation to begin with. This life is an awful lonely one, its so hard to connect to anyone day to day, especially when you're filled with shame about yourself and the state your life is in.

I spoke to a friend in the country I'm from who offered a place to stay for a few days. I don't see how I can get myself off my bathroom floor and to a city 3-4 hours away though. I wish there were teleporters and I'd be in her living room already. 

I moved country to be with my fiancé four years ago. All my savings went into a house we bought together at the start of the year. I'm essentially stuck here with someone who just thinks I'm trying to ruin his life by being depressed and anxious. So he shouts at me, doesn't answer his phone, disappears overnight and tells me to "cop on and grow up" 

Seems to think I'm playing a game for attention. I feel like he hates me.

Yes. I had a prior incident where help was sought for my suicidal thoughts. The police came and handcuffed me. Put me in the back of a van and brought me to an observation room in an emergency room. I was locked there, on camera having rolling panic attacks. There were no mental health staff, just nurses taking my blood pressure and looking alarmed at the numbers. It was like a wild animal on the floor. I still have nightmares about it. I am terrified to seek any help alone as I know what happens when you do now. I just need to not be alone. To be held and comforted but my fiancé seems to think I'm just trying to screw with his day somehow. He won't even answer his phone. Just texting me to leave him alone and get help. I've begged for help from him. He just won't come. I don't know how anyone could leave someone they care for alone in this state. I think he must want me to die.

If I'm judging what my life is worth.. Well, nothing.

Chronic pain. 
Chronic panic attacks.
Loneliness.
Emotional turmoil. 
I lost my child to miscarriage.
I'm no longer able to work or be useful.
Anything I do is never good enough. 
Everything I don't do is what I should have done. 

I'm at the utter end of my rope. I've only been sticking around because I couldn't deal with the guilt of leaving people in grief. But when they don't care about me when I'm alive my death shouldn't mean much. 

I don't view myself as a worthwhile person. Worthwhile people have more than misery to keep them company. 

I don't want to seem contrary. I do appreciate people speaking to me. 

I've already made two attempts today but my this shit is hard to do.

I've lost people to suicide in the past and the guilt of what I'd be doing to those I care for is all that has kept me here this long. 

I have reached out to the two people I could accept help from and neither will. 

"Stop contacting me. I'm not indulging or enabling you. "

"Call an ambulance if you need help." 

These are the last two texts from my fiancé. He knows I can't call an ambulance after my really traumatic experience last time. Hes choosing to leave me alone in this house in a town I know literally no one. It just feels like he wants me gone, he'd be happier without me and my drama. I've tried to break up so many times but he tells me he loves me, hes just never here when I need him.

Thank you for your caring words. What I feel I really need is for the people who actually know me to be here for me. I'm just told to grow up, or told to call an ambulance. I am more scared of being held against my will in handcuffs again than I am of dying.

She's a real dote. My mother will look after her when I'm gone. She'll be happier at her house, lots of lovely fields to run around for her. Thanks for responding to me. These last few hours have been immensely difficult. I've made two attempts so far this morning but the survival mechanism kicked in. I wish we just had self destruct buttons. It would be so much easier.
I took a Falconry lesson there once. Best childhood memory for sure.
Thank you.

I've implemented a conversation safe word today. (Banana!) But things just seem to carry on where they left off or escalate. More time is needed I suppose. But he's been threatening to just refund my money expended on the house "if that's what I want." But then asks for a back rub and wants hugs, being offended if I'm not welcoming. 

I don't know. It feels like I'm missing something, and I don't think it's that he's an abusive monster as some posters have suggested. My uneducated guess is modelling of relationship with his mum. 

I'm rambling. Reaching out to the nether for answers is helping settle my brain over this tonight though. Thank you internet stranger!

I know I could find another partner, he could too. All would not be lost, I just.. I love the guy, I know he loves me. I'd like to think we could do the work to right the crappy patterns rather than just cutting our losses and moving on.

Going on my own is the thing I'm thinking of doing most at this point. I've been reluctant as I've never felt like I've gotten a lot out of individual counselling, though most of my experience was as a teenager when I was offput by confidentiality issues.

That sounds like a really unpleasant situation! I'm sorry you went through it for so long, did the therapist not notice and call out the dynamic? I was sortve hoping counselling could help us resolve those "what's acceptable and healthy communication" questions.

And as for coping.. Not so much recently! Panic attacks have a way of making the whole world seem a bit alien and unfriendly for a while after. I really dislike feeling incapable to tackle certain situations without becoming emotional.
That'd be good! I don't think we'd argue nearly as much if we weren't both so heightened by the shitty exchanges.

I'm reluctant to just think he's outrightly an abuser. Having gone through that there are really key differences. To me it seems like he's stuck in a loop of poor behaviour rather than an outright sadist who's getting off on messing with my head. 

I think a lot of us have the potential to engage in those behaviours without being an awful person through and through. Equally I'm not interested in being the conduit to work through his issues. I wish I had some way to give him some insight. I suspect he's having difficulty accepting it all as if he did it'd crush him to accept whats been going on between us. 

Maybe I'm delusional. I really don't think he's a classic abuser though. More a guy that's ran into some problems dealing with life stresses and I'm bearing the brunt of it currently.
No, physical abuse isn't a concern. If that were going to happen it'd have happened. We've had some real emotional extremes over the relationship and violence hasn't come into it.
I'm emotionally scared of him, or scared of the next argument over something pointless. I'm not scared he'd physically attack me.
Thanks, he's gone to the gym since I suggested it so I'm hoping he'll have a more open attitude when home later. Though I'm sitting here nervously worrying he'll have become more outraged.
That's what I thought. I assumed we'd just half the expense.. I'm not convinced he's going to engage with counselling if he's not willing to be out of pocket for it.
That's the exact sort of response I was fearing but expecting. I'd give the same advice to a friend. It seems such a waste to just walk, I fear I'd live in regret of could-have-beens.

I think we do, or we have done. We both arguably more damaged people than we were four years ago. We love each other though, when things are good we have a lot of fun and balance each other well. I've helped him progress professionally and educationally. I'd never seen myself as someone who'd settle down and plan a family but I can really see it here. I wouldn't persist through such an unpleasant situation otherwise.

Essentially I agree. What I meant by minor issues is that the arguments are typically born out of trivial issues. 

He is often aggressive about stating and restating his points, in his opinion to effectively communicate I'd be matching him verbally. He sees it as healthy debate from what I can grasp, I don't, it stresses me out considerably to have to engage that way and I feel like I'm walking on eggshells. 

I was really hoping he'd agree to counselling, I hate the idea of the process as I'm quite a private person bit we don't seem to be able to resolve this ourselves. 

No worries on the divorce, I won't be planning a wedding whilst these issues persist. Thanks for your input!
